```{=html}
<div class="career-app focused-page">
<section id="jobs" class="section-block">
<div class="section-heading"><div><p class="eyebrow">US PHARMACEUTICAL EMPLOYERS</p><h2>Explore roles across employers.</h2></div><a class="text-link" href="outputs/us-employer-inventory/curated/us-jobs.parquet" download>Download US inventory ↓</a></div>
<p class="section-intro">Pharmaceutical data work spans commercial decisions, clinical research, informatics and operations. This collection brings those US roles together by employer, career level and data source.</p>
<p id="raw-coverage" class="context-note"></p><p class="tiny">Dates refer to the original posting where available. First recorded identifies the collection date when the posting date is missing. <a href="outputs/us-employer-inventory/curated/all-employer-records.parquet" download>Complete source metadata (Parquet)</a>.</p><p id="employer-count" class="context-note" role="status"></p>
<div class="filters">
<label>Analytics relevance<select id="job-relevance"><option value="all" selected>All US jobs</option><option value="analytics">Analytics-relevant jobs</option><option value="other">Other US jobs (screen not matched)</option></select></label>
<label>Employer<select id="job-employer"><option value="__all__" selected>All employers</option></select></label>
<label>Search title or skill<input id="job-search" type="search" placeholder="SQL, analyst, market access"></label>
<label>Career level<select id="job-level"><option value="all">All levels</option><option value="Analyst / specialist">Analyst / specialist</option><option value="Manager">Manager</option><option value="Leadership">Director / leadership</option></select></label>
<label>Data products / datasets<select id="job-signal"><option value="all">All roles (with or without mentions)</option><option value="any">Any tracked data signal</option><option>IQVIA</option><option>Symphony</option><option>MMIT</option><option>Claims data</option><option>Patient-level data</option><option>LAAD / APLD / Xponent</option></select></label>
</div>
<p class="tiny">The collection covers {{< var employers_searched >}} employers across all available dates. Matching source identities are counted once. These historical advertisements have not been verified as current openings.</p><details><summary>Compare employer counts for this combination</summary><div id="employer-summary" class="table-responsive"></div><p class="tiny">Combined = Local + Azure − In both.</p></details><p id="employer-detail" class="context-note" role="status"></p>
<p id="job-count" class="tiny" role="status" aria-live="polite"></p><div id="job-cards" class="job-grid"></div><div id="job-pagination" class="hero-actions" hidden><button id="job-prev" type="button" class="button secondary">Previous</button><span id="job-page" role="status"></span><button id="job-next" type="button" class="button secondary">Next</button></div>
<p class="context-note">Roles differ in their degree, experience and specialist requirements. Manager and director postings describe responsibilities typically reached through prior professional experience.</p>
</section></div>
```
